port.name: Name

aircraft.title: Aircraft types

instance.title: Instance settings
instance.subtitle: Name, registration and base URL of this TravStats instance.

name.label: Instance name
name.help: Shown in the UI, in outgoing emails and backup metadata.

frontendUrl.label: Public URL
frontendUrl.help: Base URL used for invitation links and password-reset emails. Leave empty to auto-detect from the request URL.

publicUrl.label: Public URL (device pairing)
publicUrl.help: Externally reachable address of this instance, used for the device-pairing QR code so the mobile app can connect from outside the LAN. Leave empty to auto-detect from the request URL.

lanUrl.label: Internal URL (LAN)
lanUrl.help: Optional local address of this instance for devices on the same network (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3010).

maxUsers.label: Maximum users
maxUsers.help: Hard cap on the number of accounts. Recommended 1–10 for small groups.

allowRegistration.label: Allow public registration
allowRegistration.help: When enabled, new users can register without an invitation link (not recommended).

betaFeatures.label: Show beta features
betaFeatures.help: Reveals unfinished features for everyone on this instance. For testing only — beta features may change or disappear again.
betaFeatures.listEmpty: Nothing is behind the switch at the moment.
betaFeatures.listNote: This list is read from the registry in the source, so it always matches what this build actually gates.

tripAiSummary.name: AI trip summary
tripAiSummary.what: A button on the trip detail page that summarises the journey in prose.

passport.name: Passport
passport.what: A page of stamps, continent quotas and a country table, built from your flight data.

domainColors.name: Custom domain colours
domainColors.what: Makes the per-domain colour a setting rather than a brand constant. Applies to statistics, the trip timeline, the activity rail and the import log.

poiDomain.name: Places
poiDomain.what: The whole Places domain: create, edit, detail page, list, map, custom lists and the shipped checklists.

passkeys.title: Passkeys (WebAuthn)
passkeys.subtitle: Lets users sign in with a fingerprint, face, PIN or password manager. Passkeys need HTTPS — browsers refuse them on a plain LAN address.
passkeys.statusUsable: Passkeys are usable on this instance.

status.notConfigured: Not set up yet — add at least one origin below.
status.insecureOrigin: Not usable: the first origin is not HTTPS. Only localhost is exempt.
status.invalidRpId: Not usable: the passkey domain is not a valid domain.

rpId.label: Passkey domain
rpId.help: The bare domain only — no https:// and no port. Leave empty to derive it from the first origin. NOTE: a passkey is bound to this value forever; changing it later breaks every passkey already registered.

origins.label: Allowed origins
origins.help: One per line, with scheme and port if any. The first one is authoritative. Several only make sense when they share the same passkey domain (e.g. app.example.com and www.example.com).

webdav.title: WebDAV sync
webdav.subtitle: Mirror backups to a remote WebDAV share (Nextcloud, HiDrive, …).

enabled.label: Enable WebDAV sync
enabled.help: After each successful backup the archive is uploaded to the remote share.

url.label: WebDAV URL
url.help: Full URL up to your user root, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/abrechen2/

password.label: Password
password.help: Stored encrypted at rest (AES-GCM). For Nextcloud use an app password.

backupPath.label: Remote backup path
backupPath.help: Subfolder on the WebDAV share where backups are stored.

users.title: User Management

deleteConfirm.title: Delete user?
deleteConfirm.message:
Permanently delete user "{{username}}" and all their data (flights, trips, achievements, settings)?

This action cannot be undone.

generate.description: Generates a random temporary password (12 characters).
generate.mustChange: Must change password on next login

set.mustChange: Must change password on next login

resetTwoFactorConfirm.title: Reset two-factor
resetTwoFactorConfirm.message: Turn off two-factor sign-in for “{{username}}”? Their next sign-in will need the password only. This is the way back into the account when both the phone AND the recovery codes are gone.

users.description: Everyone on this instance — change roles and deactivate accounts. A deactivated account can no longer sign in; its data is kept.

invitations.title: Manage Invitations
invitations.confirmRevoke: Really revoke this invitation? The link becomes invalid immediately.

createLinkModal.title: Create a new invitation link
createLinkModal.description: Generates a single-use link you can share however you like.

createEmailModal.title: Invite by email
createEmailModal.description: We create a single-use link and mail it directly to the address you enter.

success.title: Invitation created
success.linkStillValid: The link below is still valid — share it manually.

invitations.description: Invitation links for new users. Each link works exactly once and expires after seven days.

userLimitWarning.title: ⚠️ User Limit Warning
userLimitWarning.message: You have reached the recommended user limit ({{maxUsers}} users). Performance may be affected with more users.

demoWarning.title: 🔓 Demo Account Active
demoWarning.message: The demo user account (username: "demo", password: "demo123") is currently active. It is created automatically with sample data on first start. When you no longer need it, delete it here — all demo data (flights, cruises, trips) is removed with it.

systemInfo.title: System Information
systemInfo.buildVersionHint: Version that was baked into the container image at build time. This only differs from the displayed version when a promoted RC is running — the image is byte-identical to the tested RC, while the registry tag already points to the final version.
systemInfo.exportDescription: Exports all user data as JSON — for backups and for analysis.

airlineLogos.title: Airline logos
airlineLogos.description: Check the stored logos against their sources and refresh the stale ones. This also runs nightly.

export.description: Export all user data as a JSON file.
export.title: Data Export
export.confirmMessage: This will download a JSON file with all user data.

toasts.cleanupComplete: Cleanup complete! Deleted {{filesDeleted}} files, freed {{spaceFreed}} MB

prompts.confirmExport: Export all data? This will download a JSON file with all user data.
prompts.confirmDeleteLog: Delete log file "{{filename}}"? This action cannot be undone.
prompts.confirmCleanupLogs: Delete old log files based on retention policy? This action cannot be undone.
prompts.confirmDeleteDemo: Delete the demo user account? All demo data (flights, cruises, trips, achievements) will be removed too. Cannot be undone.

logging.title: Debug Logging & Diagnostics
logging.description: Controls the logging behavior of the system. Debug mode enables detailed output for troubleshooting.

help.levels: error → warn → info → debug → trace (from least to most detailed)
help.warning: Debug mode can impact performance and generates large log files. Only enable for short diagnostic periods.

debugActive.title: Debug Mode Active
debugActive.message: Debug logging is enabled with detailed instrumentation. This may impact performance and generate large log files. Consider disabling after troubleshooting.

level.label: Log Level
level.hint: Higher levels include all lower levels (e.g., Debug includes Info, Warn, Error)

retention.label: Log Retention (Days)
retention.hint: Log files older than this will be automatically deleted

http.label: Log HTTP Requests
http.hint: Log all HTTP requests with timing, IP, user, and status (category: http)

database.label: Log Database Queries
database.hint: Log SQL queries with args and performance metrics (category: database)

parser.label: Log Parser Operations
parser.hint: Log LLM operations with provider details (category: parser)

parserSettings.title: Global Parser Configuration
parserSettings.description: Default parsers for all users. Local ones are free; cloud AI costs per request and needs a key.
parserSettings.defaultSettingsDescription: These defaults will be applied to new user accounts. Users can change them in their settings.
parserSettings.autoHelp: Auto mode automatically selects the best available parser

ollama.title: Ollama LLM Parser
ollama.description: Ollama runs locally or on your network and analyzes booking confirmations with an LLM. Ideal for multi-stop and complex emails.

backup.title: Backup Management
backup.description: Backups capture all data on this instance and can be restored after data loss or a move. A restore replaces the current data entirely — take another backup first.
backup.deleteConfirm: Do you really want to delete the backup from {{date}}?

restore.title: Restore Backup
restore.warning: Warning: This action will replace all current data!

globalApiKeys.title: Global API Keys
globalApiKeys.description: These keys apply to every user and act as a fallback for anyone who has not stored their own. A user's own key always takes precedence.
globalApiKeys.parserApisDescription: API keys for AI-powered email and boarding pass parsing.
globalApiKeys.flightApisDescription: API keys for automatic flight data lookup and updates.
globalApiKeys.permissionsDescription: Control whether users can provide their own API keys.
globalApiKeys.allowUserParserApiKeys: Allow users to set their own parser API keys
globalApiKeys.allowUserParserApiKeysDescription: Users can enter their own OpenAI/Claude API keys in their settings. Their keys will take precedence over global keys.
globalApiKeys.requireUserParserApiKeys: Require users to provide their own parser API keys
globalApiKeys.requireUserParserApiKeysDescription: Force users to provide their own API keys. Global keys will not be used. Only free parsers (Ollama, Tesseract, Regex) will work without user keys.
globalApiKeys.allowUserFlightApiKeys: Allow users to set their own flight API keys
globalApiKeys.allowUserFlightApiKeysDescription: Users can enter their own flight lookup API keys. Their keys will take precedence over global keys.

openai.label: OpenAI API Key
openai.description: Used for AI-powered email and boarding pass parsing

claude.label: Claude API Key
claude.description: Used for AI-powered email and boarding pass parsing

airlabs.label: AirLabs API Key
airlabs.description: Free tier: 1000 requests/month. Shared with all users for flight data lookup.

aviationstack.label: Aviationstack API Key
aviationstack.description: Paid service. Shared with all users for flight data lookup with higher accuracy.

aerodatabox.label: AeroDataBox API Key
aerodatabox.description: Free via RapidAPI: 600 units/month. Closes the gap for historical flights up to a year back. Shared with all users.

opensky.label: OpenSky Network
opensky.description: Free service. Requires registration. Shared with all users for flight data lookup.

logostream.label: Airline logos (logostream.dev)
logostream.description: Provides airline logos as icon, wordmark and dark-mode variants. Without a key only the basic full logos (Daisycon) are shown.

googlePlaces.label: Google Places (lodging locations)
googlePlaces.description: Optional. Without a key TravStats looks positions up in OpenStreetMap only — free, but hotels are often simply not in it. With a key, Google is asked as the last tier because it knows businesses: measured on 30 real names, OpenStreetMap found 14 lodgings, Google 27. The free tier covers this comfortably.

masterData.showingOf: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} entries — refine the search to see more.
masterData.typeToSearch: Type at least two characters to search the catalogue.
masterData.refineSearch: More matches than shown — refine the search.

scopeHint: Applies to the whole instance — for every user.

fxCdn.title: Exchange rates
fxCdn.label: Fetch rates for currencies the ECB does not publish from cdn.jsdelivr.net
fxCdn.description: The ECB publishes 30 currencies. With this off, exactly those stay convertible; everything else is stored and shown but marked “no rate” and left out of totals. With it on, this instance asks the free jsDelivr dataset for the rest — only for rates the ECB lacks, and without a key.
